newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P AFFIRMS HYUNDAI CREDIT RATING, LOWERS OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: S&P AFFIRMS HYUNDAI CREDIT RATING, LOWERS OUTLOOK.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Thursday it affirmed its BBB+ long-term credit rating on Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, but revised the rating's outlook to negative from stable.
Hyundai Motors faces heightened uncertainties in the Korean automobile industry triggered by the recent problems of the Kia Group, the ratings agency said.

Hyundai Motor may take part in a joint ownership plan for ailing Kia Steel Co, along with Daewoo Motor Co Ltd and Kia Motors Corp, and this could increase the financial burden on Hyundai Motor and the Hyundai Group, S&P said.

Market shares in the Korean domestic automobile market have been fluctuating, with increased sales penetration by Daewoo Motor, in addition to deep discounting by Kia Motor to reduce inventory levels, it said.
S&P said the expected entry of Samsung Motor was another destabilising factor for the automobile industry, given the firm's strong interest in acquiring existing automakers.

Unstable industry conditions and the potential financial burden related to Kia Steel could adversely affect Hyundai Motor's operating performance and financial profile in the short to medium term, S&P said.
